content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert firing — PD-12345 — p99 latency for route /v1/generate in us-west > 800ms (3m). Trigger: latency-service.p99 > 800ms.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-12345 assigned to @oncall-lena
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: ACK — taking this. pinging SRE to confirm scope.
raj: raj: on it, pulling metrics now.
sre-dylan: sre-dylan: quick glance — hosted us-west only. p99 jumped ~350ms -> ~920ms, p95 flat. no spike in 5xx.
carla: carla: dashboard: https://redwood/ops/dashboards/latency?range=15m — looks like a tail shift starting ~1769998800 :eyes: 
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: running a quick histogram query: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))` — tail moved right.
raj: raj: KV cache eviction rate spiked around 1769998790, maybe noisy hotkeys.
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: proposed mitigation: temporarily reduce batch size (16 -> 8) on hosted pool and divert 10% traffic to eu-west fallback. executing in a minute.
carla: carla: please paste exact patch when you run it.
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: running patch now: `kubectl -n hosted patch deploy inference-runtime --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"serve","env":[{"name":"BATCH_SIZE","value":"8"}]}}]}}}'`
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-12345 acknowledged by oncall-lena — escalation timer paused.
sre-dylan: sre-dylan: applied routing weight override: us-west weight 0.9 -> 0.9, eu-west 0.1 (10% fallback). watching for 2m windows.
carla: carla: telemetry after patch: p99 trending down to ~650ms within the last 5m. KV evictions decreasing.
raj: raj: confirming eviction rate dropped ~70% after batch change.
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: leaving page open for 15m. if p99 < 700ms for two consecutive 5m windows we can resolve.
carla: carla: customer impact note — support volume for US region doubled for latency complaints but no backend errors/500s yet. recommend a short eta note to support.
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: @support-team heads up: US hosted endpoints experiencing higher latency, mitigation applied (batch size reduced, 10% traffic routed to EU). ETA to stabilize ~15-20m.
sre-dylan: sre-dylan: canary checks look clean — no regressions in output or error rates. rollback ready if tail worsens.
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: update (10m): p99 now ~560ms, p95 steady. continuing to monitor for another 10m. great work :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident-bot: Alert PD-12345 resolved and closed by oncall-lena.
carla: carla: will file a short post-incident note (root suspects: transient KV hotkey causing cache thrash -> tail latency).
oncall-lena: oncall-lena: thanks team — handing off to eng-sre for follow-up RCA and guardrail ticket. closing thread in 10 if stable. :white_check_mark:
